checks.name: server_start
checks.detail: PORT=3001 node server.js started. curl -v http://localhost:3001/ returned HTTP/1.1 200 OK with Content-Type: text/html; charset=utf-8. Note: HEAD request returns 404 (server only handles GET), but GET / works correctly.

ac_results.note: server.js imports WebSocketServer from 'ws' and attaches to httpServer. No SSE or polling code found.
server code in server.js, client HTML in public/index.html — confirmed as separate files.
package.json scripts.start='node server.js', dependency ws=^8.18.0. node_modules present. GET http://localhost:3001/ returns 200 with HTML.
client sends {type:'join', nickname} in ws.addEventListener('open'). Server handles 'join' case, validates nickname, sends {type:'joined'} ack. Tested in S1/S5 integration test.
broadcast() sends {type:'message', nickname, text} to all clients including sender via for..of clients Map iteration. Confirmed S1/S3 tests: alice sees own message alice:hello.
Sender self-receive confirmed: S1 test alice sees [alice:hello, bob:hi alice] — alice's own message appears in her received list via server loopback broadcast.
No writeFile/appendFile/db found in server.js. In-memory Map only. Server restart would clear all state.
scheduleReconnect() implements exponential backoff: delay = 3000 * 2^retryCount, max 5 retries, then error display. Code at public/index.html lines 191-204.
server.js isValidNickname() checks typeof string && trim().length > 0. S5 integration test confirmed: empty, whitespace-only, and undefined all return {type:'error'}.
server.js isValidMessage() checks trim().length > 0 && <= 1000. S2 integration test: empty '' and '   ' sent, 0 messages received on watcher client.
A11 integration test: client sent {type:'message'} without prior join, watcher received 0 messages. server.js: if (!clients.has(ws)) return; at line 96-98.
A12 integration test: sent 'not-json-at-all' and {type:'unknown_type'}. Server did not crash; subsequent valid message 'still-alive' delivered to watcher.

public/index.html: joinBtn.disabled when nicknameInput.value.trim().length===0 (line 99). sendBtn.disabled when msgInput.value.trim().length===0 (line 213). sendMessage() returns early if !text (line 219).

Optional AC met. server.js broadcasts {type:'system', text:'nickname が参加しました'} on join (line 87) and {type:'system', text:'nickname が退室しました'} on close (line 121). Client renders system messages with appendSystemMessage().

scenarios.note: Integration test: alice joined, bob joined. alice sent 'hello', bob sent 'hi alice'. alice sees [alice:hello, bob:hi alice], bob sees [alice:hello, bob:hi alice]. Both bidirectional.
Integration test: c1 (tester) joined, c2 (watcher) joined. c1 sent {text:''} and {text:'   '}. watcher received 0 message-type frames after 600ms wait.
Integration test: alice3, bob3, carol3 joined. alice3 sent 'broadcast-test'. All 3 clients (recv1, recv2, recv3) confirmed receiving the message.

Integration test: alice4, bob4, carol4 joined. carol4 closed connection. alice4 sent 'after-disconnect'. Both alice4 and bob4 received the message. Server-side close handler removes disconnected client from Map.
Integration test: '' → type=error, '   ' → type=error, undefined → type=error. All three empty/whitespace/undefined nickname attempts returned server-side error response.

suggestions: HEAD /index.html returns 404: server only handles GET method. curl -I (HEAD) shows 404 while curl -v (GET) shows 200. Not an AC requirement but may confuse health-check tooling.
A14 system messages appear in S1 test flow as well (broadcast of alice/bob join). Client-side filtering is implemented correctly with msg-system class.
MAX_MESSAGE_LENGTH=1000 enforced server-side (isValidMessage), client also maxlength=1000 on input. Consistent double-defense.
